background.tile: result/player{slot+1}.png frame1 ('WIN' 80x80) tiled over whole screen
center: result/player{slot+1}.png frame0 at (W/2,H/2) (anchor hx/hy places the badge)
result/{charName}.png frame0 at (W/2,H/2) — winner's character face, charName = player+4 (character01..06)

reel.cards: all DAT_00448724 (=16) word cards, image dat\WordCard\<jpg> (assets: images/cards/*.jpg), stacked vertically, wrap-around
reel.clip: x0=OX+0xc3 (195), y0=OY+0xb7 (183), w,h = first card image size
reel.stopHuman: winner human (player+0x3c==0): key-DOWN of button 0/1 on own device; plays drip.wav, stops drum_long loop, plays drum_short
reel.decel: after stop: speed -1 per tick down to 0; at 0 if no card top equals y0 → speed=1 (crawl) until aligned; selected = first card whose y == y0

pressButton.pos: (W*5/6, H/2+200); frame1 base, frame0 at +bob (bob range -10..2)

message.text: maindata Misc.winnerMsg = '%s得到一張「%s」四字真言！' (player name, card name)
message.pos: centred x, y=H/2+0xdc, white with black outline (DAT_004488d8 font)

wordCardResult.onEnd: card appended to winner's hand (player+0x20 list) via FUN_00423140; pop scene stack (restores board fps)

scoreResult.object: FUN_0041e8c0(int scores[4]) — created inside the game scene
assets: minigame/result2/bg.png (RESULT title bar, 637x87) at (W/2, y) with y easing from 0 to H/2 (div 8)
scoreResult.rows: participants (score!=-1) sorted by score descending (qsort FUN_0041ed00); rank k row target y = OY+140+k*77, x = W/2; row starts at y=H+200 and after delay 30*(k+1) ticks eases to target (div 4); draw: row bar (x,y), face at (x+5,y), rank number at (x-0x95,y), score '%d' at (x - textW/2 + 0x9c, y-10)
scoreResult.onEnd: each participant's cash (player+0x28) += score; done flag → game pops scene
